title: A chainsaw is not a traffic plan

ai.summary: A local protest in Ganderbal, Kashmir, opposes cutting heritage Chinar trees to widen Duderhama Hospital Road, arguing that traffic bottlenecks stem from poor traffic management rather than the trees.

facts.claim: traffic bottlenecks on Duderhama Hospital Road
facts.quote: As traffic bottlenecks grow more frustrating on this vital stretch
four majestic Chinar trees stand as silent witnesses

facts.claim: cutting trees is not a permanent solution
facts.quote: This is called ‘Induced Demand’, where wider roads only invite more traffic in 3-4 years
On paper, we already have the full bypass network

facts.claim: Power Canal Road is a permanent solution
facts.quote: Power Canal Road restoration is the only permanent solution

ai.background_note: The protest focuses on urban planning and environmental issues in Ganderbal, Kashmir, highlighting the misuse of heritage trees as scapegoats for traffic problems.
